weatherBasis.description: Typical meteorological year using solar and wind data from AUS_TAS_Cape.Grim.Baseline.Air.Pollution.Stn.959540_TMYx.2011-2025.epw at Cape.Grim.Baseline.Air.Pollution.Stn (WMO 959540), applied to the dispatch period by calendar hour. It represents typical rather than extreme years, so it does not contain the tail weather events that drive storage and reliability outcomes.
